title: Enterprise Connectivity: support entitlement for payout
content:
## Application
Enterprise Connectivity applies this support entitlement for payout rule to assisted overpayment payout.

## Basis: support fraction
For assisted overpayment payout, read the portfolio reduction fraction from the unique active Support holding for the same customer and legal billing entity; use zero when there is none.

## Basis Q&A
| Assisted overpayment payout basis | Consequence for this action |
| --- | --- |
| Assisted overpayment payout: Read the portfolio reduction fraction from the unique active Support holding for the same customer and legal billing entity | use zero when there is none. |

## No matching holding case
For a hypothetical assisted overpayment payout with no active Support holding matching both the customer and legal billing entity, the assistance fraction is zero. An active holding for a different legal billing entity does not provide a matching entitlement.
